name: When should I get a CMA for my waterfront property?

mainEntity.name: When should I get a CMA for my waterfront property?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should get a CMA for your waterfront property when you are considering selling, refinancing, or disputing your property tax assessment. It provides an up-to-date estimate of your property's market value, which is vital for making informed decisions. For sellers in Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, or Orange County, obtaining a CMA before listing helps set a realistic and competitive price, preventing overpricing that can lead to long market times or underpricing that leaves money on the table. This preparation ensures you enter the market with a strategic advantage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get a waterfront CMA when considering selling, refinancing, or tax assessment disputes to understand your property's current market value.
